name: Bleh CFG-init sampler
plain: Runs a few pre-steps scaled from raw x before handing off to a wrapped sampler. So it does extra integration with no model call.
math: Per step: d by mode: afs d=x/√(1+σ²); other: x/√(1+(10σ)²)/10; or x/σ. x+=d·dt. Then wrapped sampler on remaining sigmas.

providers.author: blepping
providers.note: Other bleh SAMPLER nodes: BlehInsaneChainSampler, BlehForceSeedSampler, attention wrappers

label: from code
surprise: Analytic "CFG zero init" style steps happen without any model evaluation.
